title: AgentModelConfig
description: Schema for .github/agents/model-config.json — defines approved models, tier mappings, and per-agent model assignments.

_comment.description: Human-readable comment; not processed by tooling.

approvedModels.description: Registry of approved model keys and their concrete model names. Tiers reference these keys. Keep names in sync with GitHub Settings → Copilot → Models.

availableModels.description: Optional approvedModels keys the target host offers. When set, --strict requires the first model of every tier to be in this list, because the Copilot SDK/CLI host uses only the first entry and never falls back.

tiers.description: Named tiers that reference one approvedModels key or an ordered list of keys. The sync script validates registry membership and resolves keys to model names.

name.description: Agent identifier; must match the basename of the corresponding {name}.agent.md file (without extension).

tier.description: Key of the tier (defined in 'tiers') whose model list this agent uses.

primary.description: Older name for 'tier': key of the tier (defined in 'tiers') to use for this agent. 'tier' wins when both are set.

thinkingEffort.description: Optional thinking-effort hint written to agent frontmatter alongside the model.

notes.description: Free-text description of this agent's role. Not written to agent files.
